verdict.rationale: Unstructured documents multi-file batch processing as its own capability. Jobs partition, chunk and embed local files in one run. Workflows ingest content from source connectors such as Azure Blob Storage and Box and process it from source to destination. The Job APIs let you inspect any files that failed in a run, and the sample scripts handle whole directories. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of bulk processing limits or scale, bulk management actions across many workflows or jobs at once, and independent or hands-on corroboration of large-batch runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: The sample scripts also handle multiple files in a directory, which you can try later with your own files.
Trigger runs, monitor status, download results, and inspect any files that failed during processing.
Create a job to partition, chunk, and embed local files into AI-ready JSON with vector embeddings for semantic search.
Create, update, run, and delete workflows that process and transform documents from source to destination.
Ingest your files into Unstructured from Azure Blob Storage.
